name: Data warehousing patterns
tagline: Surrogate keys, slowly changing dimensions, fact table types, role-playing and junk dimensions, calendars, time zones and currencies.
seo: Data warehousing patterns for Power BI developers: SCD type 2, unknown members, early-arriving facts, accumulating and periodic snapshots, role-playing and junk dimensions, 4-4-5 calendars, time zones and multi-currency, with checked answers.
intro: The patterns behind every good star schema, practised on Northwind data with SQL and Power BI. These are the ideas that make the difference between a model that answers today's question and one that still answers next year's: history that doesn't rewrite itself, facts at the right grain, and dates, time zones and currencies handled on purpose.
setup: Use the company pack plus the files in data/tracks/warehousing (customer_changes, early_orders, order_events, web_sessions_local). Any SQL engine works; the model answers are portable SQL tested in CI.
